name: Sustainability at Thai Wah
problem: Currently, Thai Wah relies on external consultants every year for GHG data collection, calculation, and pre-verification readiness (Scope 1-3), resulting in high costs. This knowledge and data does not build the capability or strength of our own people, and cannot be used to answer customer, investor, or partner questions in real time. On top of this, the SEC Thailand disclosure requirements tightening between 2027 and 2030 will further increase workload and consultant costs if we do not first put in place a strong internal data system, a system for tracking external regulatory/data updates, and a robust pre-verification process.
whyTrack: Our team sees that this project can apply Digital Tools and AI (automated data extraction, Emission Factor matching, and data anomaly detection) to address our reliance on external consultants at the initial stage. This clearly delivers on cost reduction, while also building internal organizational capability and preparing us for increasingly stringent ESG standards in the future.
tools: Excel / Power BI Dashboard, AI Chatbot / Assistant
